mapper.sql: select ticket_id, ticket_no, applicant, ticket_type, priority, status, handler, title, description, complete_time, device_info, symptom, impact_scope, tried_actions, ai_source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from it_ticket
mapper.select: where status = 'pending' and create_time <= date_sub(sysdate(), interval 24 hour) order by create_time asc

select t.ticket_id as ticketId, t.ticket_no as ticketNo, t.ticket_type as ticketType, t.title as title, t.description as description, t.device_info as deviceInfo, t.symptom as symptom, t.impact_scope as impactScope, (select r.process_note from it_ticket_record r where r.ticket_id = t.ticket_id and r.action = 'PROCESS' and r.process_note is not null order by r.record_id desc limit 1) as processNote from it_ticket t where t.status in ('completed', 'closed') order by t.ticket_id desc limit 500
mapper.insert: insert into it_ticket(ticket_no, applicant, ticket_type, priority, status, handler, title, description, complete_time, device_info, symptom, impact_scope, tried_actions, ai_source, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{ticketNo}, #{applicant}, #{ticketType}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{handler}, #{title}, #{description}, #{completeTime}, #{deviceInfo}, #{symptom}, #{impactScope}, #{triedActions}, #{aiSource}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
